emily (sales): Quick heads-up — ACME procurement sent back the MSA+DPA with 3 redlines: net45 payment, additional subprocessor clause, and higher SLA penalties. They also want the order form routed to procurement before legal.
raj (acct_exec): Thanks. Are the SLA penalty numbers material? any $$ hit?
emily (sales): They bumped uptime SLA from 99.9 -> 99.99 and added a $5k/day service credit cap. engineering/ops worry that 99.99 on multi-region POC is risky.
maria (legal): Can you paste the exact clause? I need to see wording. If it's a fixed $5k/day cap that's okay but check the definition of "downtime" — they widened it to include degraded performance.
jane_procurement: We need an invoice with PO line and net45 on the order form. Their legal insisted procurement must sign the OF first for internal routing.
bill_finance: Net45 is fine if we escalate to finance for approval. Need W-9/tax form and they want credit hold removed until PO is received.
oliver_sec: They also attached a security questionnaire (CAIQ + our SOC2). I flagged that subprocessor list change. They want mandatory breach notification within 24h. That's pretty aggressive.
sam_se: For the POC, we're offering hosted API dev keys on a sandbox account. If they require a private deployment for coverage, that will change cost/lead time. FYI: prefix caching will improve perf; we should document expected p99 latency.
emily (sales): Alex — can you confirm procurement routing/order they need? they said procurement signs OF before legal signs MSA.
alex (customer): Yup — internal rule. Procurement needs a completed OF + PO number to release funds. Legal can sign MSA afterward but procurement won't start without OF/PO.
raj (acct_exec): Ok. Practical question — can we provide a provisional OF (no PO number) that procurement accepts and then they append PO later?
maria (legal): We can provide an "Order Form — Pending PO" template with signature block and note: "PO to be provided within 30 days". Need product to confirm pricing lines.
sam_se: Pricing lines: 1) Hosted API dev seat (monthly) 2) POC reserved throughput (2 GPUs) 3) Overages per token. I'll paste a minimal snippet: ```
Item: POC Reserved Capacity
Qty: 2 GPU-weeks
Price: $4,000/week
Term: 4 weeks
Billing: Net45
``` 
bill_finance: Put billing contact and remit address on OF. Also note: we require electronic invoices to ap@redwood.ai.
ej: (typo)
emily (sales): @maria can you confirm if 24h breach notif is acceptable?
maria (legal): 24h is tough — propose 72h with immediate acknowledgement within 24h and a follow-up plan within 72h. I'll redline.
oliver_sec: 72h ack + 24h initial heads-up works for us if they remove the mandatory forensic SLA.
jane_procurement: If we send the provisional OF, procurement at ACME will accept and issue PO within 7 business days. Need docusign route: procurement -> finance -> legal -> exec.
emily (sales): Route order: procurement_jane -> bill_finance -> maria -> raj -> exec (alex). Can docusign-bot handle multi-step signer order?
docusign-bot: DocuSign workflow accepted: sequential signing with signer order: procurement_jane, bill_finance, maria (as "reviewer"), raj, alex. Autocomplete: disabled.
raj (acct_exec): Maria — once you redline MSA/DPA, can you also sign off on the OF template? we want to avoid back-and-forth.
maria (legal): I'll draft redlines tonight and attach the OF template with the "Pending PO" note.
emily (sales): Great. Sam — can you prepare an appendix with expected latency p50/p90/p99 and known POC limitations to attach to OF?
sam_se: On it. Will include quant numbers and a short ops playbook (how to escalate to dedicated if they need lower latency).
alex (customer): One more ask — can pricing be locked for 90 days? procurement wants price protection while internal approvals happen.
bill_finance: 90-day price lock is acceptable for a POC as long as terms say "counts only if PO issued." emily (sales): Summarize next steps: 1) Maria redlines MSA/DPA and adjusts breach notif to 72h 2) Sam prepares appendix + pricing lines 3) Emily sends provisional OF via DocuSign with signer order 4) Finance watches for PO and processes net45 invoicing.
maria (legal): I'll send redline diff and OF template by EOD.
sam_se: Appendix ready by tomorrow 11am PT.
emily (sales): Thanks team. I'll queue the DocuSign envelope after Maria's sign-off. :thumbsup:
raj (acct_exec): If procurement delays PO beyond 30 days, we re-open pricing conversation. Noted.
alex (customer): Thanks everyone — I'll nudge procurement to prioritize.
emily (sales): Closing note: @oliver_sec I'll loop you in on the appended security attachments before sending.
oliver_sec: Thanks, appreciate it.
